correctness.rationale: The interpolation-derived difference recurrence, two-step monodromy, characteristic quartic, Cayley transformation and exact positive Hurwitz-determinant polynomial certificates were all symbolically reconstructed by the standalone verifier. The all-r disk classification follows analytically from the sign of the reciprocal sextic, whose cubic has a unique root greater than two; at criticality the -1 multiplier is simple and others stable. The proof covers all r>0 without relying on numerical samples.

value.rationale: A sharp exact reciprocal if-and-only-if stability boundary across every positive alternating step ratio is a natural complete classification with numerical-method design relevance, a rigorously located neutral endpoint and a one-mode instability certificate. It establishes an order-five transition not inferable from the previously known isolated r=10 instability or order-four unconditional result. It does not claim arbitrary grids, nonzero test equations or uniform near-endpoint bounds.
